description: This header file defines the interface for the SNMP Adapter module in a TR-181 device management context. It includes class declarations, method signatures, external dependencies, and detailed comments describing the purpose and functionality of the SNMP adapter, primarily for device information retrieval and configuration via SNMP.

classes.name: hostIf_snmpAdapter
classes.description: Class providing an interface for SNMP communication with device parameters, including singleton pattern methods and SNMP get/set operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP Adapter singleton instances.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Deinitializes and cleans up the SNMP Adapter instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of the SNMP Adapter for a specific device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and deallocates a specific SNMP Adapter instance.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all current SNMP Adapter instances.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes all existing SNMP Adapter instances.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: getNotifyHash
methods.description: Returns the hash table for SNMP notification subscriptions.

methods.name: get_ValueFromSNMPAdapter
methods.description: Performs SNMP GET operation based on device info to retrieve parameter value.

methods.name: set_ValueToSNMPAdapter
methods.description: Performs SNMP SET operation to configure device parameter.
